name: Viloxazine
metabolism: Mainly metabolized through CYP2D6, UGT1A9 and UGT2B15. The major circulating metabolite is 5-hydroxyviloxazine glucuronide; elimination is predominantly renal.
summary: Viloxazine is an oral selective norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor used to treat attention deficit hyperactivity disorder in children and adults. It was previously marketed as an antidepressant.
